effect_description_eng:
＜Scapegoat＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted other than by your effects, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon, prevent that deletion.)
[When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [SoC] or [SEEKERS] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
[All Turns] When Tamer cards are placed in this Digimon's digivolution cards, activate 1 of this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effects. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack a player.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon are deleted, if this Digimon has [Fenriloogamon] in its name, trash your opponent's top security card.
